svg.text: Agentic Curator · how one run flows
Orchestrator plans · subagents work in parallel · every file touch goes through MCP · nothing is deleted without your approval

g.text: one session per run · tools discovered at start
You start a run (dry-run by default)
Orchestrator splits the job into phases
Bus fans tasks out to six subagents
Subagents act only through MCP tools
Server reads, hashes and fingerprints files
Safety Policy builds a plan you approve
